notes_for_editor: Only two sources, a county tower compilation (undated author, Wikimedia Commons PDF) and the FFLA roster; neither gives a build year, so the story has no built sentence. The two coordinate pairs differ slightly (about 90 m apart by my arithmetic); both are kept. The PDF's 1978 survey line is split across layout lines, so the 'tower is' quote is a fragment. No photos, staffing or fire history found; two WebSearch calls used. The 1978 note on this entry says 'gone' and 'bulldozed'; it does not say 'removed'. Record fields otherwise match the sources.
